scripts.dev:server: cross-env ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development DOTREACT_RENDERER_TOKEN=dotreact-dev dotnet watch --project Server/Server.csproj run --no-launch-profile --urls http://127.0.0.1:5080
scripts.generate: dotnet build Server/Server.csproj -c Release && dotnet run --project ../../dotnet/src/DotReact.TypeGen/DotReact.TypeGen.csproj -- Server/bin/Release/net10.0/Server.dll src/contracts.ts --discover --manifest src/backend-manifest.json --actions src/actions.ts
scripts.check:contracts: dotnet build Server/Server.csproj -c Release && dotnet run --project ../../dotnet/src/DotReact.TypeGen/DotReact.TypeGen.csproj -- Server/bin/Release/net10.0/Server.dll src/contracts.ts --discover --manifest src/backend-manifest.json --actions src/actions.ts --check
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build:client && npm run build:ssr && dotnet build Server/Server.csproj -c Release
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && dotreact-check --project tsconfig.json --manifest src/backend-manifest.json --contracts src/contracts.ts
